from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    base = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbase = [v for v in flat if v != base]
    divider = Counter(nonbase).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special = {v for v in set(flat) if v not in (base, divider)}
    if not special:
        return [[base]]
    row_lanes = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] in special for c in range(w))]
    col_lanes = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in special for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(row_lanes)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(col_lanes)-1):
            vals=[grid[row_lanes[i+dr]][col_lanes[j+dc]] for dr in (0,1) for dc in (0,1)]
            marked=[v for v in vals if v in special]
            row.append(marked[0] if len(marked)==4 and len(set(marked))==1 else base)
        out.append(row)
    return out

program='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Decode a matrix encoded by colored marks on a regular grid of dividers."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    base = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = Counter(value for value in counts.elements() if value != base).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked_colors = {value for value in counts if value not in (base, divider)}

    row_lanes = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] in marked_colors for c in range(w))]
    col_lanes = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in marked_colors for r in range(h))]

    result = []
    for i in range(len(row_lanes) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_lanes) - 1):
            block = [grid[row_lanes[i + dr]][col_lanes[j + dc]]
                     for dr in (0, 1) for dc in (0, 1)]
            row.append(block[0] if block[0] in marked_colors and len(set(block)) == 1 else base)
        result.append(row)
    return result
'''
